name: terrain_prefetch_drive
note: Terrain prefetch ring coverage (hash compare + worker count). 64x64-sample tiles, max_tile_fills_per_tick 2 so the initial 50-tile load drains over ~25 ticks and most of it installs from prefetched tickets (swap install), prefetch_margin_tiles 1 and prefetch_max_tiles 64 (both points' margin rings, 2 x 24 keys, hold a Done ticket each, plus room for the leading edge of the driven point). Interest point 1 holds the dynamic balls; interest point 2 is the one tests/determinism/test_worker_count_hash.cpp drives across tile rows in C++ (scenario interest points are static, so ps_run covers the initial load only). Prefetch on and off must give the same state_hash.
